'''Nick Harvey''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Colorado Springs tournament (14 October)]] on 14 October 2001 with [[Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|DBO]], according to Patrick Napier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3058">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-15-colorado-springs-a-good-choice-10-14-01d3058/ colorado-springs-a-good-choice-10-14-01], DeckTech (Patrick "Pappy" Napier, 15 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-15-colorado-springs-a-good-choice-10-14-01d3058/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
